shots.action: HOOK: Kai (headphones, split purple/orange hoodie) with a GIANT head jammed in the school doorway, legs kicking, panicking
shots.camera: low angle push-in from the street, fast zoom punch on 'stuck'
shots.narration: In this town, I told one tiny lie, and now my head is stuck in the school door!

shots.action: Wide of the blocky suburb: red and blue roofs, people walking; a man lies and his head POPS one size bigger
shots.camera: drone shot descending, whip to the man
shots.narration: Because in this town, every time you lie, your head grows one block bigger!

shots.action: Little sister with cookie crumbs on her face says 'I didn't eat them' — BOOP, her head grows
shots.camera: medium shot, quick zoom on her head
shots.narration: Everybody knows it! My little sister said she didn't eat the cookies. Boop! Her head grew.

shots.action: Mayor in top hat at a podium promising roads; road full of holes behind him; his head grows huge beside his car
shots.camera: low angle on the mayor, then wide showing head vs car
shots.narration: The mayor said he'd fix every road. Now his head is bigger than his car!

shots.action: Weatherman in front of a sunny-weather sign; his giant head casts a shadow over the whole block
shots.camera: tilt up from the sign to the head
shots.narration: The weatherman promised sunshine. Now his head blocks the sun!

shots.action: Kai's dog with an absurdly big blocky head, wagging; Kai shrugs at camera
shots.camera: static close, then snap zoom on the dog
shots.narration: Even my dog has a big head! Don't ask!

shots.action: Everyone in town with normal heads, smiling and honest; Kai alone, sweating, side-eye
shots.narration: So in this town, everyone tells the truth. Everyone... except me.

shots.action: Classroom morning; Kai at a front desk digs in his empty backpack, panic
shots.narration: This morning, I forgot my homework.

shots.action: Teacher (red outfit, bun) leans in, arms crossed: 'Kai, where is your homework?'
shots.narration: My teacher looked at me. "Kai, where is your homework?"

shots.action: Kai fake smile: 'My dog ate it'
shots.narration: And I said... "My dog ate it."

shots.action: BONK! Kai's head grows one block; whole class gasps
shots.camera: crash zoom on the head, then whip to the class gasping
shots.narration: Bonk! My head grew one block. The whole class gasped!

shots.action: 'A dinosaur ate it!' BONK — head bigger, knocks his desk
shots.narration: "I mean, a dinosaur ate it!" Bonk! Bigger!

shots.action: 'A dinosaur riding a dragon!' BONK BONK BONK — head grows three times in a row, desk breaks
shots.narration: "A dinosaur riding a dragon!" Bonk! Bonk! Bonk!

shots.action: Head as big as a fridge, filling the frame; headphones snap off and fly; kids laughing and pointing
shots.camera: wide from the board, kids in the foreground
shots.narration: Now my head was as big as a fridge. My headphones snapped! Everybody was laughing.

shots.action: Kai yells 'It's not that big!' — BONK, head smashes through the ceiling
shots.camera: low angle looking up, debris falling
shots.narration: "It's not that big!" I yelled. Bonk! My head smashed right through the ceiling!

shots.action: Outside: Kai's giant head sticking out of the school roof; birds land on his hair; an airplane swerves away
shots.narration: Birds landed in my hair. An airplane had to turn around!

shots.action: Best friend takes a selfie with the giant head; phone screen shows '1,000,000 likes'
shots.narration: My best friend took a selfie with my giant head. A million likes!

shots.action: Kai tries to run home but the head gets stuck in the school door (the hook moment, now in context)
shots.camera: same angle as the hook, matched cut
shots.narration: I tried to run home, but I got stuck in the school door.

shots.action: Principal runs up: 'Kai, just tell the truth!'
shots.narration: The principal came running. "Kai, just tell the truth!"

shots.action: Kai's eyes shaking, scared; imagine-bubble of him in big trouble
shots.narration: But I was scared. If I told the truth, I'd be in SO much trouble!

shots.action: Flashback: sister says sorry for the cookies — POP — her head shrinks back
shots.narration: Then I noticed something. My sister said sorry for the cookies, and her head shrank back. Pop!

shots.action: Kai's lightbulb moment: 'The truth makes it smaller!'
shots.narration: The truth makes it smaller!

shots.action: Kai takes a deep breath, chest puffs
shots.narration: So I took a deep breath.

shots.action: 'I didn't do my homework, I played video games all night' — POP, head shrinks one size
shots.narration: "I didn't do my homework. I played video games all night." Pop!

shots.action: 'I ate the last slice of pizza' — POP, smaller
shots.narration: "And I ate the last slice of pizza." Pop!

shots.action: 'I broke the window!' — POP POP POP, head back to normal size, he pops free from the door
shots.narration: "And I'm the one who broke the window!" Pop! Pop! Pop!

shots.action: Everybody cheers, confetti; sister hands him a cookie
shots.narration: My head was normal again. Everybody cheered! Even my sister gave me a cookie.

shots.action: Teacher smiling: 'Thank you for the truth, Kai. Now you have double homework.' Drops a huge stack of papers
shots.camera: medium on teacher, then the paper stack lands
shots.narration: My teacher smiled. "Thank you for the truth, Kai. Now you have double homework."

shots.action: Kai: 'I love homework!' — BONK, head grows again. Freeze frame
shots.camera: crash zoom on the head, freeze
shots.narration: And I said, "I love homework!" Bonk!
